issues.spec_citation: SQL-on-FHIR v2.1.0-pre ViewDefinition logical model: resource 1..1 ResourceType code, profile 0..* canonical(StructureDefinition), fhirVersion 0..* FHIRVersion code binding.
issues.evidence: Fresh .temp/qa/sof_vd01_historian_probe.py showed ViewDefinition.to_dict() succeeds for direct dataclass values that violate root logical-model fields: resource=["Patient"], resource="DefinitelyNotAResource", fhirVersion="4.0.1" (serialized as characters), fhirVersion=["9.9.9"], and invalid meta.profile. Parser and SQLGenerator reject adjacent cases; serializer can emit invalid JSON.
issues.root_cause: ViewDefinition.to_dict() hand-built root JSON without reusing parser/generator root logical-model validators, so direct dataclass values could bypass ResourceType, canonical profile, FHIRVersion, and metadata profile guards.
issues.resolution: Added shared validate_resource_type() and validate_fhir_version_array() helpers in viewdef/types.py; routed parser, SQLGenerator, and ViewDefinition.to_dict() through the shared root validators; to_dict() now validates root metadata via validate_root_metadata_fields(). Added serializer regression coverage.
